question:
**Complete the sentence with an appropriate ANTONYM of the word mentioned in the bracket.**

The old house was so ________ (sturdy) that it could be shattered into pieces with a single blow.
solution: The correct answer is '**fragile**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Sturdy**' is '**Fragile**' • **Sturdy**: (of an object) strong and not easily damaged (जल्‍दी न टूटने वाला, मज़बूत, दृढ़) • *Example: *That ladder doesn't look sturdy enough to hold you. • **Fragile**: easily damaged or broken (नाजुक) • *Example: *He sat down on the fragile chair. **Correct Answer:__** Fragile*.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **wry**: expressing both disappointment and amusement. (जिसमें निराशा के साथ विनोद का भाव भी हो) • **competent**: having the ability or skill needed for something. (सक्षम, योग्‍य) • **subdued**: (used about a person) quieter and with less energy than usual. [(व्‍यक्ति) अभिभूत; शांत तथा सामान्‍य से कम ऊर्जा सहित] 38:T8a6, The correct answer is, '**across'**
